help: Independent local corpus in this block's persistent storage. Inputs cannot select another corpus.
Literal text search: all words, any word, or a consecutive phrase. No raw query language or semantic model.
Maximum returned excerpts. Scores rank this query; they are not confidence probabilities.
Maximum retained identities, including removal tombstones that protect against stale revisions. No automatic eviction.
Maximum indexed sections in this corpus.
Total stored text character limit. A batch is accepted or rejected atomically.
Maximum UTF-8 bytes per input event.
One deadline per event, including a bounded database lock wait.
